latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Git Assistant, an AI-powered tool for improving git workflow.

- Generates Conventional Commits-compliant commit messages from staged changes.
- Reviews commit messages for quality and adherence to conventions.
- Creates changelogs and detailed release notes from git history.
- Produces PR descriptions from branch diffs.
- Supports local and AI-assisted commands; requires EvoLink API key for AI features.
- No destructive git operations; all analysis is read-only.
